summary.text: Ariel Defay is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives who has represented District 15 since November 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ariel Defay was appointed to the Utah House of Representatives to replace Brad R. Wilson, and she assumed office on November 15, 2023, according to Ballotpedia.
The Republican primary for her seat on June 23, 2026, was canceled.
